While the cowboys struggle with how to raise the money, Bubba is torn if he should ask his father-in-law for help. Booger teaches Matthew to be a real cowboy and gives him his first pony! But when Jaclyn misses this big milestone, she questions if her demanding job is keeping her from her family. And finally, Cody's mission to teach kids about the importance of ranching leads him to take on the Cattlemen's Association. How far will he go to make his point?

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: It's back to basics on The Cowboy Way as the guys work to rotate cattle off a lightning-struck field to fresh grass, but the routine wrangle suddenly heads south as the herd scatters, jumping and taking down part of a fence. Kaley wonders about finances and if she should find work, while Bubba invests in a starter herd for daughter Andie's Cowgirl College Fund. Jaclyn rushes to prepare for Matthew's 4th birthday party and anxiously waits for news after a job interview. Booger's parents have a special birthday surprise for Matthew. As the Cattlemen's Association Ambassador, Cody gets a call from a local farmer and meets their autistic son Tristan. Misty gives Cody an idea how to share the cowboy way lifestyle with this special boy.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Wealthy Frenchman Cesar Tiffauges, who is used to getting whatever he desires, wants to buy the McCain Ranch. Tiffauges, a sadistic man, abuses his followers regularly with beatings. When Lucas refuses, his son Mark becomes the object of cruelty.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Dan Willard fills in as deputy while Marshal Micah Torrance is away on business. Meanwhile, Texas cowhands come to town looking for fun and relaxation. When Dan tries to prove that his toughness, those actions backfire.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: Yellow Bird is a white woman who was abducted as a child by Apaches and raised as one of their own. Her father, a wealthy Texan, finds her and wants her to return home. She agrees, but only if she can marry Captain Parmenter in the process.

programme.title: The Ballot of Corporal Agarn
programme.desc: Two mayoral candidates from Agarn's hometown of Passaic, New Jersey, travel to Fort Courage to get his vote. With the election tied, each candidate needs Agarn's absentee ballot to win. O'Rourke schemes on a way to make Agarn's decision pay off.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Law Comes to No Man's Land
programme.desc: Marshal Chris Madsen helps newly appointed judge John Buford bring law and order to Oklahoma's Panhandle in an area known as No Man's Land. After escorting a wagon train of prisoners to Beaver City, they set up their first courthouse inside a saloon.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When bandits rob a train and gun down a pursuing marshal, they spark one of the largest manhunts in California history. After taking shelter behind the crumbling walls of Stone Corral, they make their final stand against a hail of gunfire.

programme.desc: Coming of age on the frontier, young Bill Hamilton joins Old Bill Williams on an epic adventure during the final days of the fur trade. The last true mountain man, Hamilton's courage is tested when he faces an epic showdown with Bannock warriors.

programme.desc: Cody joins a troupe of traveling actors, unaware that the group's members are Confederates who are plotting to assassinate U.S. General Fremont. When the riders discover the truth, they ride to Fort Laramie to save Fremont from getting murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Lace
programme.desc: If a case or situation doesn't go her way, Lacey won't hesitate to trade on her discretion with her service, whether in law enforcement or the private sector. She's mastered the art of the deal, but as she builds influence, she's also making rivals on both sides of the law. A loyal staff and tunnel vision have kept it all together so far, but as the lines between her business blur, one mishap or unexpected event can put her at a disadvantage, if only for a moment. And a moment may be all it takes for her operation to crumble.

programme.title: Lace
programme.desc: Othello and the twin enforcers meet with the billionaire husband of Daniel's alleged rape victim. Britney gets a call in the middle of the night that leads to an horrifying discovery. Daniel despairs in county lockup while Lacey and her team try to post bail.

programme.title: Lace
programme.desc: An unnerved Lacey goes to the county jail, only to make a shocking discovery. Othello goes the extra mile to get leverage for a client who's getting lowballed on a mega-real estate deal isn't working out.

programme.title: Lace
programme.desc: Lacey takes on a new case, but has ulterior motives. Daniel tells Lacey about a possible new witness, but Lacey doubts his credibility.

programme.title: Lace
programme.desc: Othello secures another win for the firm, but when he gets too close to Lacey, things don't go as expected. Things are further complicated when Othello gets another offer.

programme.title: Lace
programme.desc: Lacey's enemies plot their revenge. Othello considers a compelling offer. Mark gets stunning news about Zoe. With the pressure mounting, Lacey begins to unravel.

programme.title: Lace

programme.desc: Chelsea tells Lacey she's secured the meeting with her father, Gov. Barclay, who is the only one who can pardon Tony, but it will cost her. Lacey and Gideon meet to strategize about her defense.

programme.desc: With Governor Barclay now at her mercy, things start to turn around for Lacey. Britney meets with Alphonso in jail, offers to represent him pro-bono. Judge Sears vents at Peter Corbin's lack of results around Lacey.

programme.desc: Agent Diggs meets with Lacey's enemies, to persuade them to work with the FBI and to testify against Lacey. Big D watches the Governor's insincere speech with contempt as he 'recycles the same bullshit he said 20 years ago.'

programme.desc: Rev. McCullough welcomes back Tony as the First Lady of Holy Spirit church. Meanwhile, during his draft workout for the LA Cheetahs, Frank Marzili advises Savoy not to sign with Daniel McCullough.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Despite having 3,000 bottles of shampoo, 30,000 shirts, 5,000 cookbooks, and boxes on top of boxes of things, Kristen says she doesn’t think she is a hoarder. But Kristen claims her “collection of things” has created a problem. She just bought a new house and after already moving in 600 boxes, she says she's completely running out of room, and there is a whole lot more to pack. From buying unclaimed storage containers to dumpster diving, Kristen says she cannot give up an opportunity to collect something that’s a good deal. But is there more to Kristen’s collecting than meets the eye? Find out the shocking reason Kristen says it is hard for her to part with her belongings. Plus, meet Kristen’s friends who say they are concerned that her “hoarding” is keeping their friend isolated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracy is a successful, working actress who has appeared on many daytime soap operas including The Bold and The Beautiful and The Young and The Restless. She wrote into the show urgently seeking Dr. Phil’s help for her real-life drama of her hoarding 71-year-old-mother, Robin, who could be evicted from her home at any minute. Tracy claims her mother’s homes have always been filled with filth, chaos, and animals, and she’s never taken responsibility for the conditions Tracy lived in growing up. Tracy says she feels like the child of a drug addict, except the drug is hoarding, and she’s looking for Dr. Phil’s help to truly change her mom’s behavior before she’s back in another house of filth again. Robin says she knows she needs help with her hoarding, but the idea of getting rid of her possessions gives her anxiety. She says she’s ready to fix herself with the help of Dr. Phil, and this show is an answer to her prayers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What’s a woman to do when her spouse is constantly standing over her shoulder and nitpicking everything she does? Michelle says her husband, Jim, has controlled her for the 15 years that they’ve been together, and she’s fed up with his faultfinding. She says he tells her what to wear, how much she should eat, and even uses a GPS to track her whereabouts! Jim admits that his behavior is out of control and fears that he could be pushing his wife out the door. Why is he so critical of Michelle, and can Dr. Phil get the judgmental hubby to change his ways? Then, Sally says her husband, John, is so controlling that she spends most of her days picking up dust bunnies from the floor and only speaking when he allows her to. John says cleanliness is next to godliness and believes control is a matter of perception. See what causes him to go toe to toe with Dr. Phil! Will the couple get the help they’re seeking? It’s an explosive Dr. Phil you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents are concerned about the extreme measures their daughters take to get and keep a boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents who force their children to live an extreme, harsh existence.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Twenty-one-year-old Bailey says eight months ago, she “liked” a tweet from a complete stranger and it was love at first post. Bailey says their romance is like no other love story you’ve ever heard, but the shocking thing is this stranger has never met Bailey, and she wants her to stop sending thousands of messages professing her love. Bailey’s mom, Ericka, says she’s lost her daughter to this fixation she has with this stranger, and she wants her daughter back. When Bailey finds out she will be sharing the stage with her mom, Bailey storms off because she says she hates her mom. Will she come back and talk to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bloody attacks, arrests, mug shots and undercover stings - Dr. Phil explores these extreme outcomes of in-law conflicts. Meet two wives whose rocky relationships with their in-laws led to criminal consequences.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Son Is Like A Wild Animal!
programme.desc: Sylvia and her ex-husband, John, say their 24-year-old son, Johnny, has extreme anger issues and threatens to kill them -- and despite having him arrested and committed to psych wards, their efforts to help him have failed. What’s at the root of Johnny’s rage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Moms confront freeloading children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A 7-year-old boy's knives fascination and violent imaginary friend injured teachers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Linda and Rich say their three 20-something daughters are all hooked on heroin -- and the parents disagree about how to handle the situation. Linda admits she enables her daughters by giving them money, paying their bills and providing a place to stay, but she says she just can’t kick them out -- like Rich wants to do. Dr. Phil gives the couple an uncensored look at a day in their daughters’ lives -- obtaining money at any cost, buying drugs and shooting up together. Will this be the eye-opener the parents need to stop enabling their daughters and help save their lives? And, will the siblings accept help under Dr. Phil’s one big, non-negotiable condition?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of missing Stacy Peterson is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a three-part series, a man makes a shocking confession to his wife, only after he failed a polygraph test.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Husband Obsessed: A Wife Accused
programme.desc: The conversation continues as Dr. Phil examines Mike's alleged evidence that his wife cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents terrified that their kids are headed down a destructive path turn to Dr. Phil for some advice. Shelly says that her 15-year-old daughter, Allie, was the perfect child before partying and drinking took over her life. Allie has been cited several times for public intoxication, and also has been caught stealing prescription drugs. Shelly fears her daughter won't make it to her 18th birthday. Dr. Phil wants Allie to meet someone who could leave a lasting impression. Then, Kim is scared that her 16-year-old daughter, Briana, has unprotected sex with older men. Dr. Phil gives Briana a wake-up call she'll never forget. And, a teen who has spent over 400 hours in tanning beds says she’s not concerned about the health risks.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a rare interview, Dina Lohan sets the record straight.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Carol and Tab’s 20-year-old son, Alex, was killed by a hit and run driver. They believe that Alex’s death was no accident and they accuse Rob, 24, of being responsible. Rob, joined by his mother, Linda, and sister, Lenora, 21, says he’s being falsely accused and placed in the middle of an “unrelenting witch hunt,” and he just wants everyone to move on. See what happens when he comes face to face with Alex’s family on Dr. Phil’s stage. Why wasn’t Rob tried on vehicular homicide charges? Hear from a crime scene reconstruction expert hired by the family. Has he uncovered new evidence? Don’t miss this riveting Dr. Phil mystery as the victim’s family confronts the young man they believe deliberately killed their son.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Penny filed for divorce from her abusive husband, Brad, he retaliated by shooting her three times, attacking her with a machete, hitting her over the head with a shovel and murdering her best friend, Leslie, in cold blood — all in front of their four children. Penny survived the attack and Brad is serving 32 years in prison, but she says her emotional wounds are far from healed. Can Dr. Phil help her find peace for herself and her family? This program contains graphic and disturbing content. Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alan says he's being falsely accused of a heinous crime, and his accuser is his own mother-in-law! She claims he molested his 3-year-old daughter. Who's telling the truth? Find out when Dr. Phil reads the results of Alan's polygraph exam. Can this family heal and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: I Was Acquitted, My Ex Says Guilty
programme.desc: A woman confronts accusations of her involvement in her son's accidental overdose.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Baronica and Nathan say that on July 10, 2021, their then 9-year-old son shot his 8-year-old brother in the chest with one of six unsecured guns in their home. The parents bravely come forward to tell their story in hopes that other parents will learn from their mistakes. Then, Kristin says the last time she saw her 15-year-old son, Ethan, he was heading to his best friend’s house. Within hours, she was informed Ethan had been killed by an unsecured gun in his best friend’s house. Kristin has fought to have Ethan’s Law enacted in CT, which ensures that parents are held accountable for the safe storage of their weapons. And, hear from Susan, whose daughter Amanda was sitting on a park bench when she was shot by a group of young people, leaving her paralyzed. Plus, Ryan Busse, a former gun industry executive who says he left the industry after seeing how fear tactics were being used to sell guns, joins the conversation. This is a show every parent needs to watch -- whether you own a firearm or not.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests are trying to dig themselves out of their self-made messes. Can a two-timing womanizer change his ways for good? Or is the saying, "Once a cheater, always a cheater" the truth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This two-syllable expression is arguably the most divisive word in society. Dr. Phil tackles this touchy topic with help from a panel of outspoken luminaries: civil rights activist Rev. Al Sharpton; legendary comedian and writer Paul Mooney; CSI :New York actor and author Hill Harper; comedian Sheryl Underwood and conservative radio talk show host Michael Graham.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever feel nervous before posting on social media? Have you ever censored your own thoughts because you worry that you could be criticized or even canceled for posting your beliefs? Dr. Phil and his guests discuss the self-censorship debate on the internet and social media, including the fundamental misunderstanding about the true extent of “freedom of speech” under the First Amendment. Kimberly, a University of Tennessee doctoral candidate, claims her college violated her freedom of speech after a professional conduct committee determined that she had posted unprofessional content to her social media. What rights do colleges have to spy on personal social media posts? Also Tehran Von Ghasri, a comedian who performs on college campuses, says cancel culture gone too far. How does the fear of being canceled affects the jokes he performs for college students or content he posts online? Alexandra, a social media influencer and business owner, says giving opinions about COVID got her censored and three accounts closed. What did she say to get canceled? Dr. Phil also talks with Attorney Robert Shibley, a Senior Fellow at the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE), who says over half of Americans are not saying how they feel for fear of offending others or being canceled. Jessica Levinson, an attorney and a Clinical Professor of Law at Loyola Law School, provides an explanation on the boundaries of the First Amendment. And, Gabrielle Gambrell, a Columbia University and NYU professor, says that social media sites are obligated to monitor hate and dangerous speech. Plus, find out which emojis you are probably using right now are deemed outdated or inappropriate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished finally faces her family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Hoarder Father and His Bug Infested Home!
programme.desc: Laurie says her dad, John, is in “total denial” about being an absolutely terrible hoarder. She says every room in the house is piled to the ceiling with “junk,” including the garage, where she claims she once found a “mummified kitten!” To top it off, Laurie claims the downstairs has a horrible bed bug infestation! John says his daughter is just as big of a mess as he is, has destroyed her room, and absolutely refuses to help him clear out the mess. But the junk-filled house is only the surface level of the toxicity in this home. Laurie’s ex-fiancé, Billy, also lives in the house! Laurie claims Billy is constantly getting “blackout drunk” and getting in fights with her and her father. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the dysfunction in this home and start to clean up this mess? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Hoarder Mom: Her Kids Or Her Clutter
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine discovering that your next-door neighbor owns over 200 cats. Ray and Dennis never thought their neighbor, Kristy, would let her pet collection get that big. Once friends, the three are now in a nasty and vindictive war because of the felines. Ray and Dennis say Kristy's property is one big, disgusting litter box, and they want Kristy to get rid of her cats. Kristy says she'll never part with her "cat sanctuary." Are Ray and Dennis playing dirty in order to run Kristy out of town? When is it too much, and where do you draw the line in the litter box? Then, Mike says his wife, Lori, keeps everything from used envelopes to empty food jars and medicine bottles, because she "might need it" in the future. He is ready to take desperate measures to put a stop to this. Lori says the thought of throwing her stuff out is her worst nightmare. Is Mike guilty of making nasty bribes to get his wife to change? What's really behind Lori's habit for hoarding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Despite having 3,000 bottles of shampoo, 30,000 shirts, 5,000 cookbooks, and boxes on top of boxes of things, Kristen says she doesn’t think she is a hoarder. But Kristen claims her “collection of things” has created a problem. She just bought a new house and after already moving in 600 boxes, she says she's completely running out of room, and there is a whole lot more to pack. From buying unclaimed storage containers to dumpster diving, Kristen says she cannot give up an opportunity to collect something that’s a good deal. But is there more to Kristen’s collecting than meets the eye? Find out the shocking reason Kristen says it is hard for her to part with her belongings. Plus, meet Kristen’s friends who say they are concerned that her “hoarding” is keeping their friend isolated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracy is a successful, working actress who has appeared on many daytime soap operas including The Bold and The Beautiful and The Young and The Restless. She wrote into the show urgently seeking Dr. Phil’s help for her real-life drama of her hoarding 71-year-old-mother, Robin, who could be evicted from her home at any minute. Tracy claims her mother’s homes have always been filled with filth, chaos, and animals, and she’s never taken responsibility for the conditions Tracy lived in growing up. Tracy says she feels like the child of a drug addict, except the drug is hoarding, and she’s looking for Dr. Phil’s help to truly change her mom’s behavior before she’s back in another house of filth again. Robin says she knows she needs help with her hoarding, but the idea of getting rid of her possessions gives her anxiety. She says she’s ready to fix herself with the help of Dr. Phil, and this show is an answer to her prayers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Hoarder Father and His Bug Infested Home!
programme.desc: Laurie says her dad, John, is in “total denial” about being an absolutely terrible hoarder. She says every room in the house is piled to the ceiling with “junk,” including the garage, where she claims she once found a “mummified kitten!” To top it off, Laurie claims the downstairs has a horrible bed bug infestation! John says his daughter is just as big of a mess as he is, has destroyed her room, and absolutely refuses to help him clear out the mess. But the junk-filled house is only the surface level of the toxicity in this home. Laurie’s ex-fiancé, Billy, also lives in the house! Laurie claims Billy is constantly getting “blackout drunk” and getting in fights with her and her father. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the dysfunction in this home and start to clean up this mess? Find out!

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization
programme.desc: Penelope Spheeris' The Decline Of Western Civilization is a riveting, unflinching and hard-core film which adeptly captures the spirit of a major cultural phenomenon. Including performances by X, Circle Jerks, Black Flag, Catholic Discipline, Germs and Alice Bag Band. Breaking down barriers of expression and social mores, the Decline punks were against everything: They gave birth to an anti-establishment view of the world that permeates today's music, politics, social attitudes, styles and trends. The film documents their deliberate reaction to the mass commercialism of music; it is a blatant and angry rejection of the mainstream. Burgeoning at the time, many of the punk bands first seen here have become legendary. The effect of the film on current day music, styles and trends is immeasurable.

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization, Part II: The Metal Years
programme.desc: The second in Penelope Spheeris’ trilogy, The Metal Years takes a fast-paced look at the outrageous Heavy Metal scene of the late '80s. Set in Los Angeles, the film explores fascinating portraits of struggling musicians, fans and star-struck groupies. Featuring Alice Cooper, Ozzy Osbourne, Poison and members of Aerosmith, Kiss, and Motorhead as well as performances by Megadeath, Faster Pussycat, Lizzy Borden, London, Odin and Seduce, this raucous and entertaining chapter also chronicles the lonely naiveté of the striving bands, the endless flow of alcohol and drugs and the relentless sexism.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A young man disappears in the Midwest. As detectives struggle to find leads, a desperate father turns to psychics Nita Lee and Dr. Sally Headding. Both see three men hired for a horrific killing. To help police, Sally takes detectives on a psychic odyssey, retracing the missing man's last day. A family in Pennsylvania calls the police to check on their reclusive father. Worry turns to grief when officers discover he's been murdered. Across town, psychic Jan Helen McGee awakens from a frightening dream. But it's no nightmare - she's witnessed the murder and now must help police find the killer.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: Ex Pentagon official Luis Elizondo reveals UFO bombshells Part 2
programme.desc: Luis "Lue" Elizondo is a former intelligence officer with the Department of Defense. He claims he was the director of AATIP, the Pentagon's "UFO program", from 2010-2017. In part 2 of this exclusive interview with Steven Greenstreet of "The Basement Office", Elizondo discusses the crazy physics UFOs use to move, what the government needs to reveal to the public in the upcoming June Pentagon UFO report, and whether UFOs pose "a threat."

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: What's going on inside Area 51, America's most carefully guarded secret? The mysterious military base located 30 minutes north-west of Las Vegas has been rumored to be involved in back engineering advanced alien technology recovered from UFO crash sites. Alleged Area 51 insiders have also come forward and claimed to have worked on advanced propulsion systems utilizing anti-gravity and teleportation devices there.

Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: 4x4

programme.title: How Controversy at Imola Changed F1 Forever

programme.title: Life in Pictures: Mark Webber
programme.desc: Nine-time grand prix winner Mark Webber spent 12 years in Formula 1, most of them in the teeth of adversity: from wrestling with sub-optimal machinery at Minardi and Jaguar to providing adult supervision at a young Red Bull Racing, and a not always happy partnership with Sebastian Vettel. We take you through Webber’s early career and path to F1, from his arrival in the UK and Formula Ford in 1996, to joining up with Benetton and Flavio Briatore in 2001 and his transition to Jaguar and eventually Red Bull Racing. programme.title: Never Just Win: The Making of a World Rally Champion
programme.desc: Never Just Win is a full-length documentary that looks back on the incredible 2024 World Rally Championship, which saw Thierry Neuville and Martijn Wydaeghe lift the Drivers' and Co-Drivers' titles in their Hyundai i20 N Rally1 Hybrid WRC car after an epic battle with their teammates Ott Tanak and Martin Jarveoja that went right to the final day of the season The film gives you exclusive behind-the-scenes access to the Hyundai Shell Mobis World Rally Team, featuring Esapekka Lappi and Janne Ferm, Andreas Mikkelsen and Torstein Eriksen, Dani Sordo and Cándido Carrera, Christian Loriaux, and Cyril Abiteboul, throughout one of the most dramatic and tense World Rally Championship seasons ever. Pulling no punches, Never Just Win shows you first-hand the ups and downs of the team throughout the year and exactly what it takes to win the WRC title.

programme.title: IndyCar vs Formula 1 car: Technical Comparison
programme.desc: Which is faster: Lewis Hamilton's Formula 1 car, or Scott Dixon's Indycar? Both have had major success in their respective championships, but how different are the two machines? programme.title: How Formula 1 Setups Change For Downforce Vs Power Tracks
programme.desc: What makes a Formula 1 downforce track different to a power track? We've all heard the terms before, but different tracks require vastly different car setups to get the maximum advantage around a lap. But what are these requirements? Jake Boxall-Legge dives into why Imola, Monaco, Silverstone and Monza all require different changes to a car to succeed across the board.

programme.title: The banned Lotus that wasn't actually very good
programme.desc: The twin-chassis Lotus 88 is considered the last truly ground-breaking design attempted by Colin Chapman, but we never found out how fast it could have been because it was never allowed to race. However, as Giorgio Piola reveals, while rivals feared the concept, its drivers were not convinced the 88 would have delivered on the track. How did it work? Jake Boxall-Legge guides you through Chapman's complex idea to make ground effect cars more user-friendly.

programme.title: Tour Auto 2025
programme.desc: The Tour Auto 2025 came to an end after five days of emotion, performance and conviviality on France’s most beautiful roads. From Paris to Nice, this 34th edition brought together over 240 historic vehicles, offering a unique spectacle mixing motor sport, heritage and tradition. Setting off from the Château de Vaux-le-Vicomte in Paris on Tuesday April 8, the participants crossed exceptional landscapes and competed in timed events on circuits and closed roads. Thousands of spectators flocked to each stage, confirming the continuing enthusiasm for the event and its automotive heritage. From Paris to Nice, via Alsace and the Massif Central, each circuit and stopover town gave the competitors a warm welcome.

programme.title: The Top 10 Red Bull F1 Drivers - Part 1
programme.desc: Red Bull is much younger than Formula 1’s other big teams, having arrived in 2005. But in less than two decades it has racked up some impressive achievements. Six drivers’ and five constructors’ titles headline a CV that includes 92 world championship grand prix wins, enough for sixth on the all-time list behind Ferrari, McLaren, Mercedes, Williams and Lotus. For this list of top 10 F1 drivers, we’ve taken into account the amount of success the racers scored with Red Bull and its sister team Toro Rosso/AlphaTauri, the impact they had and the circumstances of their time within the Red Bull fold. Want to know more about our top 10 or hear experts debate the list? But each case has twists and turns and shows not all is what it seems.

programme.title: MTV Shuga Mashariki Ep 1

programme.title: MTVShuga Mashariki Ep 2
programme.desc: Students navigate budding romances and questions of intimacy amid campus tension after an assault.

programme.title: Humble Pie

Their crimes lead them to a bickering couple, Eric and Zara, and this chance meeting has everyone re-evaluating their actions.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: When crime kingpin, Chief Fubara, steps back from his empire, his sons run it into chaos. Desperate to fix their mess, he brings his daughter into the fold, only to realize it’s too late. With the government closing in and enemies everywhere, he takes control once more, but lands himself in prison. Now, his children must break him out before he's transferred to Abuja.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programme.title: Abhimaan

programme.title: Champion

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli

But she's unable to abort the illegitimate child, so she gives birth to and abandons the infant, who grows up to become the beautiful Munmun (Rekha). Munmun finds out the truth about her mother after her graduation and sets out to dig the past.

programme.title: Doli Saja Ke Rakhna

programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.

CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team enter Border country as the Roadshow visits Manderston. Amongst the items are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome Man Trap and Lord Palmer's collection of biscuit tins.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the objects under scrutiny in Rochdale's magnificent town hall are a gold pencil gifted by King George IV, paint brushes used by LS Lowry and the diaries of a British hangman.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK

programme.title: 12.12: The Day [English Dub]
programme.desc: The movie depicts the events that occurred on the night that changed the course of South Korea's history. Following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee on October 26, 1979, the citizens of Seoul had high aspirations for the democratization of their country. However, on December 12, Army Commander Jeon Doo-kwang and his allies staged a coup to seize power. The remaining army forces, led by Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin, engaged in a confrontation with the rebels, putting the fate of the country and the lives of its citizens at stake.

programme.title: A Man of Reason [English Dub]
programme.desc: After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger than him that Baby Beel will take a liking to, in order to get this monkey off his back, literally!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP01 The Revived Phantom Thief Kid [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que he tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo descubre que Randall es un violador y asesino y acuerdan ejecutarlo, pero Dale se opone porque eso los convertiría también en criminales. Mientras tanto, Carl comete un error que acarreará consecuencias imprevistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las diferencias entre Rick y Shane por el liderato del grupo y la gestión de la granja se intensifican cuando Shane decide por su cuenta el destino de Randall. La tensión termina estallando y los dos amigos se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Camping on the Ferry to Alaska
programme.desc: Our journey starts in the Pacific Northwest as we prepare to head up to Alaska on the Alaskan Marine Highway. Our passage on the Alaska Marine Highway left from the port in Bellingham Washington and would soon carry us nearly a 1000 miles north, to Juneau Alaska. The boat navigates an intricate path through the inside passage which is a narrow network of corridors through the islands on the Pacific Northwest coast of the North American Fjordlands.

programme.title: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programme.desc: Art journeys to one of the earth's most extreme environments-the high, rugged and remote Altiplano. More lunar than earthly in appearance, Bolivia's high plain is a land lost in time. The Altiplano's dazzling dreamscapes include the world's largest salt flat, an island of golden cactus, scarlet-tinted lakes, twin volcanoes and surreal skies.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari give viewers a tour of all four Hawaiian islands.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this opening episode we join host Phil Davenport at the uber luxe St Regis Bali Resort in Nusa Dua where we meet Chef Oscar Perez and his team at the resort’s lauded signature restaurant, Kayapuit, to see the preparation of some of their signature dishes.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 26: Victoria, Esposa de Don Carlos
programme.desc: Salvador, sorprendido al enterarse de que Victoria es la esposa de Don Carlos. Salvador va al baño del restaurante en el que está con Mercedes y Ramiro. Victoria lo sigue para pedirle disculpas por no haberlo comentado nunca. Él le dice que ahora, más que nunca, quiere seguir teniendo citas con ella para así hacerle daño al hombre que acabo con su carrera. Ella se pone feliz. Josefina le confiesa a Charo que la información de la revista es verdadera. Josefina le dice que le contará toda la verdad con la condición de que jamás se la cuente a Socorro. Charo aprovecha la situación y para agradarle a Coco y a Josefina, llama a Socorro y le dice que todos los chismes que han dicho de Josefina son mentira. Socorro se alegra.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 26: Encuentro Furioso en la Clinica
programme.desc: Marisela e Isadora se enfrentan en uno de los pasillos de la clínica y mientras Isadora más se altera, más comedida se ve Marisela quien le pide que no grite en la clínica y finalmente se marcha dejándola sola y furiosa. Gabriel sigue preocupado por su padre y habla con Yajaira tratando de conocer su paradero. Nancy trata de hacer callar a Isadora pero ella la insulta y la enfermera se disculpa rápidamente. Chela y Fernando detienen a Isadora en su ida a la recepción y ella furiosa ordena a Chela de mal talante que conduzca la silla de su padre. Marisela aún no se recupera de la sorpresa de ver a Isadora frente a frente pero disimula ante la atención del doctor que trata de tranquilizarla.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 69: Pascuita Descubre a Monchito y Matilde
programme.desc: Betzaida sigue esperando que Rómulo le conteste sobre esa sola palabra que le debe decir Egle a el. Rómulo no sabe que hacer pero Egle interviene y le dice una mentira, la cual Betzaida acepta. La Nena mientras conversa con Doroteo, no lo está escuchando sino lo que está haciendo es pensando sobre si le conviene o no lo conviene una relación con Doroteo. Gladis llega a trabaja a casa de Egle y se encuentra con Luís Fernando que le hace un comentario acerca de una loca que conoce, pero lo que no sabe que esa loca es la hija de Gladis. También Gladis presencia como Luís Fernando coquetea con María Gracia que se acaba de mudar para la casa, convenciéndose así más Gladis de que Luís Fernando es un sinvergüenza. Gladis llama a Dileidi que esta con Yeniluz para contarle que María Gracia se mudó a casa de Luís Fernando. Monchito después de que le da el medicamento a Pascuita, esta se duerme y el aprovecha para conectarse y tratar de hablar con Matilde pero en vista de que se le hace difícil escucharla, decide ir a casa de Matilde, sin que Pascuita se de cuenta porque ella está dormida. Gonzalo que está con su papá en el trabajo le cuenta sobre lo molesto que está con Matilde. Cuando Monchito va a casa de Matilde ellos conversan sobre el trabajo y Matilde aprovecha para contarle lo que sintió cuando los vio con Matilde diciéndole lo mucho que la quería. Monchito habla con ella y le dice lo que siente el por ella y se besan, sin saber que la cámara de la computadora los está grabando. Matilde en ese preciso momento se despierta y va a la computadora y ve a Matilde y a su marido besándose. Matilde y Monchito tienen la sensación de que alguien los observan, pero no se dan cuenta que la cámara los está grabando, y siguen besándose. Mientras que Pascuita está en su casa y no puede creer lo que está viendo, grita y llora y dice que los va a matar por lo que le están haciendo, no aguanta la presión y se desmaya. Monchito al llegar al apartamento ve a Pascuita desmayada y la auxilia sin saber qué es lo que le pasa. Dileidi sigue muy molesta por lo que le está haciendo Luís Fernando. Luís Fernando al llegar al aserradero le cuenta a Santiago lo que le paso con Dileidi y lo mentirosa que es. Matilde sola en su casa, planchando piensa sobre la situación por la que está pasando con Gonzalo y con Monchito. Cuando Pascuita vuelve en si le pregunta a Monchito, el por qué le hizo eso, y Monchito no sabe que responder, porque el no sabe que ella lo vio besándose con Matilde. Pascuita por otro lado no fue capaz de decirle la verdad a Monchito y decidió mentirle sobre el por qué se desmayo. Gladis va a visitar a Matilde y esta aprovecha para contarle el rollo que tiene con Monchito, pero como si fuera una amiga. Gladis le da consejos pero ella sabe que verdaderamente es Matilde la del rollo. Luís Fernando le cuenta a Santiago que la miss ya está viviendo en la casa, pero también se entera Tatianita. Ella corre y le dice a Felicita lo de la miss y las dos se quejan porque ahora si están en desventaja con la miss viviendo en casa de Luís Fernando. Dileidi que le contó a Yeniluz lo de la mudanza de la miss dice no importarle pero Yeniluz no lo cree. María Gracia, Cristinita y Gladis conversan sobre las casualidades de la vida, porque la hija de la señora que trabaja en la casa en donde ahora vive, estudia con ella en la universidad y también conversan sobre la gordura que supuestamente tiene María Gracias. Rómulo en el trabajo habla con Egle y le pregunta el por qué no le dijo la verdad a Betzaida sobre una sola palabra de ella y el matrimonio acaba, a lo que Egle le responde que es él el que tiene que tomar esa decisión. Betzaida al llegar a la casa le cuenta a su madre lo que escuchó hablando entre Egle y Rómulo y sobre esa sola palabra. La mamá de Betzaida le insiste en que debe casarse con Rómulo, fuese como fuese. María Gracia aprovecha que Luís Fernando se devolvió para irse con el a la universidad y así coquetear con el. Aureliano se acerca al sitio en donde Dileidi vende los periódicos y la invita a salir, pero le hace la advertencia que es una invitación especial y que si no sale con él esa noche, jamás la va a volver a invitar.

programme.title: Episodio 14: Armando Rompe el Teléfono de Daniela
programme.desc: Daniela llama por teléfono a Luis Guillermo para informarle sobre el matrimonio secreto de Raimundo. En ese momento llega Armando, su papá, y le pregunta con quién está hablando y le quita el auricular para oír, y al saber quién era tira al teléfono al suelo y lo rompe. Luis Guillermo está intrigado por saber a qué matrimonio secreto se refería Daniela. Mientras tanto, había llegado la policía a llevarse detenida a Marisela porque había sido denunciada por robo de prendas, ante lo cual Diego Andrés la acompaña a la Comisaría para abogar en su defensa. Michelle y Vicky están en el Centro Comercial y Michelle decide comprar algunas cosas y le es rechazada su tarjeta de crédito por orden de su padre, lo cual la incomoda y lo llama para recriminárselo.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Detienen a dos hombres que intentaron robar un auto; pero ellos cuentan que cuando se subieron a él, se dieron cuenta que había una persona muerta atrás…Claudia. En la UDH, reciben de parte de la viuda negra, un video de Claudia suplicando que no la maten, y en un momento nombra a la Baronesa. Entonces, Tirso y Rogelio, piensan que Inma Von Párker, es la asesina…Tirso, le dice a Alejandro, que traiga a Inmaculada y la interrogue, como se interroga a cualquier sospechoso de un crimen; pero Vanessa piensa que la viuda hace eso, para despistarlos. Alejandro y Vanessa, insisten que la Baronesa, no es la asesina. Finalmente, Sandra atiende una llamada, donde le avisan, que encontraron a Claudia muerta.

Chela y Fernando detienen a Isadora en su ida a la recepción y ella furiosa ordena a Chela de mal talante que conduzca la silla de su padre. Marisela aún no se recupera de la sorpresa de ver a Isadora frente a frente pero disimula ante la atención del doctor que trata de tranquilizarla.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 69: Pascuita Descubre a Monchito y Matilde
programme.desc: Betzaida sigue esperando que Rómulo le conteste sobre esa sola palabra que le debe decir Egle a el. Rómulo no sabe que hacer pero Egle interviene y le dice una mentira, la cual Betzaida acepta. La Nena mientras conversa con Doroteo, no lo está escuchando sino lo que está haciendo es pensando sobre si le conviene o no lo conviene una relación con Doroteo. Gladis llega a trabaja a casa de Egle y se encuentra con Luís Fernando que le hace un comentario acerca de una loca que conoce, pero lo que no sabe que esa loca es la hija de Gladis. También Gladis presencia como Luís Fernando coquetea con María Gracia que se acaba de mudar para la casa, convenciéndose así más Gladis de que Luís Fernando es un sinvergüenza. Gladis llama a Dileidi que esta con Yeniluz para contarle que María Gracia se mudó a casa de Luís Fernando. Monchito después de que le da el medicamento a Pascuita, esta se duerme y el aprovecha para conectarse y tratar de hablar con Matilde pero en vista de que se le hace difícil escucharla, decide ir a casa de Matilde, sin que Pascuita se de cuenta porque ella está dormida. Gonzalo que está con su papá en el trabajo le cuenta sobre lo molesto que está con Matilde. Cuando Monchito va a casa de Matilde ellos conversan sobre el trabajo y Matilde aprovecha para contarle lo que sintió cuando los vio con Matilde diciéndole lo mucho que la quería. Monchito habla con ella y le dice lo que siente el por ella y se besan, sin saber que la cámara de la computadora los está grabando. Matilde en ese preciso momento se despierta y va a la computadora y ve a Matilde y a su marido besándose. Matilde y Monchito tienen la sensación de que alguien los observan, pero no se dan cuenta que la cámara los está grabando, y siguen besándose. Mientras que Pascuita está en su casa y no puede creer lo que está viendo, grita y llora y dice que los va a matar por lo que le están haciendo, no aguanta la presión y se desmaya. Monchito al llegar al apartamento ve a Pascuita desmayada y la auxilia sin saber qué es lo que le pasa. Dileidi sigue muy molesta por lo que le está haciendo Luís Fernando. Luís Fernando al llegar al aserradero le cuenta a Santiago lo que le paso con Dileidi y lo mentirosa que es. Matilde sola en su casa, planchando piensa sobre la situación por la que está pasando con Gonzalo y con Monchito. Cuando Pascuita vuelve en si le pregunta a Monchito, el por qué le hizo eso, y Monchito no sabe que responder, porque el no sabe que ella lo vio besándose con Matilde. Pascuita por otro lado no fue capaz de decirle la verdad a Monchito y decidió mentirle sobre el por qué se desmayo. Gladis va a visitar a Matilde y esta aprovecha para contarle el rollo que tiene con Monchito, pero como si fuera una amiga. Gladis le da consejos pero ella sabe que verdaderamente es Matilde la del rollo. Luís Fernando le cuenta a Santiago que la miss ya está viviendo en la casa, pero también se entera Tatianita. Ella corre y le dice a Felicita lo de la miss y las dos se quejan porque ahora si están en desventaja con la miss viviendo en casa de Luís Fernando. Dileidi que le contó a Yeniluz lo de la mudanza de la miss dice no importarle pero Yeniluz no lo cree. María Gracia, Cristinita y Gladis conversan sobre las casualidades de la vida, porque la hija de la señora que trabaja en la casa en donde ahora vive, estudia con ella en la universidad y también conversan sobre la gordura que supuestamente tiene María Gracias. Rómulo en el trabajo habla con Egle y le pregunta el por qué no le dijo la verdad a Betzaida sobre una sola palabra de ella y el matrimonio acaba, a lo que Egle le responde que es él el que tiene que tomar esa decisión. Betzaida al llegar a la casa le cuenta a su madre lo que escuchó hablando entre Egle y Rómulo y sobre esa sola palabra. La mamá de Betzaida le insiste en que debe casarse con Rómulo, fuese como fuese. María Gracia aprovecha que Luís Fernando se devolvió para irse con el a la universidad y así coquetear con el. Aureliano se acerca al sitio en donde Dileidi vende los periódicos y la invita a salir, pero le hace la advertencia que es una invitación especial y que si no sale con él esa noche, jamás la va a volver a invitar.

programme.title: Episodio 14: Armando Rompe el Teléfono de Daniela
programme.desc: Daniela llama por teléfono a Luis Guillermo para informarle sobre el matrimonio secreto de Raimundo. En ese momento llega Armando, su papá, y le pregunta con quién está hablando y le quita el auricular para oír, y al saber quién era tira al teléfono al suelo y lo rompe. Luis Guillermo está intrigado por saber a qué matrimonio secreto se refería Daniela. Mientras tanto, había llegado la policía a llevarse detenida a Marisela porque había sido denunciada por robo de prendas, ante lo cual Diego Andrés la acompaña a la Comisaría para abogar en su defensa. Michelle y Vicky están en el Centro Comercial y Michelle decide comprar algunas cosas y le es rechazada su tarjeta de crédito por orden de su padre, lo cual la incomoda y lo llama para recriminárselo.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Detienen a dos hombres que intentaron robar un auto; pero ellos cuentan que cuando se subieron a él, se dieron cuenta que había una persona muerta atrás…Claudia. En la UDH, reciben de parte de la viuda negra, un video de Claudia suplicando que no la maten, y en un momento nombra a la Baronesa. Entonces, Tirso y Rogelio, piensan que Inma Von Párker, es la asesina…Tirso, le dice a Alejandro, que traiga a Inmaculada y la interrogue, como se interroga a cualquier sospechoso de un crimen; pero Vanessa piensa que la viuda hace eso, para despistarlos. Alejandro y Vanessa, insisten que la Baronesa, no es la asesina. Finalmente, Sandra atiende una llamada, donde le avisan, que encontraron a Claudia muerta.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 26: Victoria, Esposa de Don Carlos
programme.desc: Salvador, sorprendido al enterarse de que Victoria es la esposa de Don Carlos. Salvador va al baño del restaurante en el que está con Mercedes y Ramiro. Victoria lo sigue para pedirle disculpas por no haberlo comentado nunca. Él le dice que ahora, más que nunca, quiere seguir teniendo citas con ella para así hacerle daño al hombre que acabo con su carrera. Ella se pone feliz. Josefina le confiesa a Charo que la información de la revista es verdadera. Josefina le dice que le contará toda la verdad con la condición de que jamás se la cuente a Socorro. Charo aprovecha la situación y para agradarle a Coco y a Josefina, llama a Socorro y le dice que todos los chismes que han dicho de Josefina son mentira. Socorro se alegra.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Neta al fin aparece. Como corresponde, pasa un tiempo con Ivana y su familia, y con Inmaculada. Igualmente, piensa que ella no perteneces a ninguna de esas familias y prefiere regresar al barrio con su abuela Helda. En la Unidad de Homicidios siguen investigando el caso de la viuda joven, con una muerte más. La de Claudia Pardo-Pardo. Rogelio, Alejandro y Tirso se encargan de interrogar a todos los posibles asesinos. Luego de haber visitado a Iris, Simón, Christian, Jeremías, Pedro y Sonia, los últimos son los que resultan mayormente sospechosos. Puede ser que Claudia, al parecerse Sonia a la Baronesa, las haya confundido. Inmaculada quiere destruir a Ivana. Para eso, decide venderle las acciones de la chocolatera que Christian desee.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 27: Salvador Disfrazado de Batman y la Rifa
programme.desc: En medio de la despedida de soltera de una de las modelos de la agencia de Mercedes y Ramiro, Salvador sale de una torta gigante disfrazado de Batman. Todas las mujeres bailan entusiasmadas. Bárbara lo reconoce, pero no dice nada. Socorro, por el contrario, no lo hace y actúa con normalidad. Salvador va al baño, su hermana lo sigue y le hace saber que sabe todo. Salvador le pide ayuda para que Socorro no se entere. De inmediato, Bárbara saca a Socorro del lugar y Salvador queda aliviado. Las mujeres hacen una rifa para ver cuál de ellas se irá a la cama con Salvador. La ganadora es Eva, quien lo seduce para que él no se resista. Eva lo reconoce al quitarle la máscara. Él le pide discreción y ella acepta. Bárbara lleva a Socorro a su casa y la invita a dormir, Socorro acepta.

programme.title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
